text: What is the difference between a parameter and an argument?
choices: Parameters are typed and arguments are not
They are two words for the same thing
Arguments belong to constructors and parameters to methods
The parameter is the name in the definition; the argument is the value at the call site
explanation: One method has fixed parameters and sees a different argument on every call. The parameter behaves exactly like a local variable that was initialized for you, and it vanishes when the frame is discarded.
